overview: The MCL web platform has no screen for pairing or configuring temperature sensor hardware. Temperature is handled as a kind of question: you open Questions in the left menu and create a question whose Question type is Temperature. On that question you set the departments it applies to and the temperature range that counts as a good reading, and the person doing the checklist types the measured value in the MCL app. The Question management page lists every question with its type, so temperature questions are the rows whose Question type column says Temperature. The New question and Edit question windows both have three parts: Question and assignment (the question text, Question type, Departments), Answer rules (Comment and photo evidence, Evidence required when, and Positive from / To, which is the temperature range that counts as a positive answer), and Additional information (Help text and PDF URL). The question types available are 1 to 5, Free text, Numeric, Target and current, Temperature and Yes/No; there is no separate sensor type. This page was walked as a company administrator.

screenshots.description: The MCL web Question management page. A table of questions with columns Question, Question type, Departments, Status, Checklist uses and Edit / Delete links, plus a Search questions box and a New question button. Rows with Question type Temperature are the temperature checks.

steps.text: Open Questions in the left menu. The page is called Question management and lists every question with its type.
Click New question at the top right.
In Question, write what the person has to measure, for example which cooling unit to check.
In Departments, pick the departments the check belongs to, such as the chilled or frozen areas.
Under Answer rules, set Positive from and To. That is the temperature range that counts as a positive answer.
Still under Answer rules, choose whether a comment or photo can be added and when evidence is required.
Optionally add Help text or a PDF URL under Additional information, then click Save.
Open Questions in the left menu and look for rows whose Question type is Temperature.
Click Edit at the end of that row.
In the Edit question window, change Positive from and To under Answer rules.
